title: PaceVLA: Adaptive Temporal Action Quantization in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.25961v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. translated_title: PaceVLA：视觉-语言-动作模型中的自适应时间动作量化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.25961v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：快速且可靠的操作对于机器人的实际部署至关重要。尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近作为通用机器人策略取得了显著进展，但其执行在时间效率上往往仍显不足。这种低效的一个关键来源是策略从遥操作演示中学习细粒度的时间模式，需要大量的低层动作步骤。时间动作量化提供了一种简单的加速执行方法，即把连续的低层动作聚合为时间上更粗粒度的动作。然而，在不考虑何时需要细粒度控制的情况下应用动作量化会带来速度-精度之间的权衡：加速动作在某些阶段可以高效地减少冗余步骤，但在对精度敏感的交互中却会丢失关键的运动细节。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PaceVLA，一个用于VLA中自适应时间执行的统一框架……
tldr: 提出PaceVLA统一框架，通过在视觉-语言-动作模型中自适应地进行时间动作量化，在加速机器人操作执行的同时保留精度敏感交互中的关键运动细节。
en_tdlr: PaceVLA is a unified framework for adaptive temporal action quantization in Vision-Language-Action models, which accelerates robot manipulation execution while preserving critical motion details during precision-sensitive interactions.
